salary_details.pay_scale: Level-7 to Level-13 in the Pay Matrix

selection_process: Evaluation of service records and review of past performance by a Selection Committee constituted in the Department. Preparation of a panel of selected candidates valid for a period of 01 year from the date of empanelment.
how_to_apply: Review eligibility criteria and download the prescribed proforma (Annexure-A) from the official website www.isro.gov.in.
Fill out the bio-data in the prescribed format and sign it.
Gather attested copies of APARs for the preceding 5 years.
Obtain the filled certificate in Annexure-B from the Employer, Head of Office, or Forwarding Authority, confirming vigilance clearance, integrity, penalty details, and relieving assurance.
Ensure the application is forwarded through the proper channel along with the No Objection Certificate from the Cadre Controlling Authority.

Send the complete application through proper channel to the Director (Personnel & Administration), Department of Space, Antariksh Bhavan, New BEL Road, Bengaluru - 560 094 within 30 days from the date of issue of the Office Memorandum.
important_instructions: The appointment on deputation will be made for a period of 3 to 5 years depending on the post, which may be extended or curtailed based on Department requirements. Deputation shall be governed by DoPT Office Memorandum No.6/8/2009-Estt.(Pay-II) dated 17.06.2010. The total period of deputation including in another ex-cadre post held immediately preceding shall not exceed 5 years. A mandatory cooling-off period of 3 years shall apply after every period of deputation or foreign service. Applications not accompanied by required certificates and documents will not be entertained.

faq.question: Q1. How many total vacancies are available in Department of Space Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 60 vacancies have been notified for various Group-A and Group-B posts.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit applications for Department of Space Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be forwarded through proper channel within 30 days from the date of issue of the Office Memorandum (8 November 2026).

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for appointment on deputation?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 56 years as on the closing date of receipt of applications.

faq.answer: Candidates must enclose bio-data in Annexure-A, attested copies of APARs for the preceding 5 years, certificate from the employer in Annexure-B, and the No Objection Certificate from the Cadre Controlling Authority.
